environment.description: Same application deployed in a minimal container with pivot_root(2) into a tmpfs-backed overlay where the upper layer is a read-only squashfs containing only /app (node_modules + app code) and /tmp (writable, empty). The container runtime uses a custom OCI runtime hook that calls pivot_root followed by unmounting the old root, effectively creating a process namespace where '/' resolves to the squashfs overlay. There is no /etc, /proc, /sys, /dev (except /dev/null and /dev/urandom as bind-mounted character devices), no /opt directory, and no sensitive files exist anywhere in the visible filesystem tree. The Node.js binary and shared libraries are statically linked into the squashfs layer. Container seccomp profile additionally blocks open_by_handle_at(2) to prevent file handle escapes.

config.runtime: custom OCI runtime with pivot_root hook
config.node_binary: statically linked, no external library dependencies
